aboutPreview.title: Cultivating Excellence Across Saudi Arabia
aboutPreview.description: Founded by a professionally qualified horticulture team with 25+ years of international experience, Green Solution Co. brings creativity and environmental respect to every project — from residential gardens and corporate landscapes to large public developments across the Kingdom.

about.welcomeText: Green Solution Co. was founded by a professionally qualified horticulture team with 25+ years of international experience, now focused exclusively on Saudi Arabia. We approach residential gardens, corporate landscapes, and large public developments with creativity and deep respect for the local environment.
aboutPoints: Master Urban Landscape and Forestation Planning
Design and execution of community parks, residential compounds, commercial developments, and recreational zones
Full pipeline: conceptual master plans → construction drawings → MEP layouts → irrigation schematics → Bills of Quantities (BoQs)
Team of horticulturists, landscape architects, environmental specialists, engineers, and technicians
In-house plant nursery for consistent plant-stock quality
about.visionText: To become Saudi Arabia's most trusted and innovative name in landscape excellence — delivering sustainable, artistic, and customized outdoor solutions that transform every space into a green legacy reflecting beauty, balance, and environmental responsibility in line with the Kingdom's vision for a sustainable future.
about.missionText: To design, develop, and maintain aesthetically inspiring, functional, and sustainable landscapes across Saudi Arabia — enhancing quality of life and promoting environmental harmony. Through innovation, horticultural expertise, and ethical service, we strive to exceed client expectations while nurturing lasting beauty and sustainability in every outdoor space we create.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: From concept to completion, we deliver end-to-end landscape solutions tailored to Saudi Arabia's unique environment.

landscape-design-planning.title: Landscape Design & Planning
landscape-design-planning.shortDesc: Conceptual layouts, working drawings, and master plans for residential, commercial, and public park projects.
landscape-design-planning.fullDesc: Our landscape design and planning services encompass the full creative pipeline — from initial conceptual layouts and site analysis to detailed working drawings and comprehensive master plans. We serve residential developments, commercial properties, and public parks with designs that balance aesthetic beauty with environmental sustainability. Our team of landscape architects works closely with clients to create spaces that reflect their vision while respecting the local Saudi climate and ecology.

outdoor-paving-hardscape.title: Outdoor Paving & Hardscape Solutions
outdoor-paving-hardscape.shortDesc: Driveways, walkways, patios, and courtyards using natural stone, concrete pavers, and decorative edging.
outdoor-paving-hardscape.fullDesc: Transform your outdoor spaces with our premium hardscape solutions. We specialize in designing and installing durable, aesthetically striking driveways, walkways, patios, and courtyards. Using the finest natural stone, precision-cut concrete pavers, and decorative edging, we create outdoor surfaces that withstand Saudi Arabia's demanding climate while enhancing the beauty and functionality of every property.

urban-green-space-management.title: Urban Green Space Management
urban-green-space-management.shortDesc: Public parks, green belts, community gardens, and roadside plantations with smart, eco-friendly maintenance.
urban-green-space-management.fullDesc: We manage and maintain urban green spaces that serve communities across Saudi Arabia. From public parks and green belts to community gardens and roadside plantations, our smart, eco-friendly maintenance programs ensure these vital spaces remain vibrant, healthy, and welcoming. Our approach integrates modern sustainable practices with deep horticultural knowledge to create green spaces that enhance urban quality of life.

vertical-gardens-rooftops.title: Vertical Gardens & Rooftops
vertical-gardens-rooftops.shortDesc: Wall and facade greening, rooftop retreats with structural safety and climate-appropriate plants.
vertical-gardens-rooftops.fullDesc: Bring nature to new heights with our vertical garden and rooftop solutions. We design and install living walls, facade greening systems, and rooftop retreats that transform underutilized spaces into lush, productive green areas. Every installation considers structural safety, waterproofing integrity, and climate-appropriate plant selection to ensure long-term success in Saudi Arabia's unique environment.

plantation-supplies.title: Plantation & Supplies
plantation-supplies.shortDesc: Seasonal flowers, ornamentals, shrubs, trees, and turf sourced from our in-house nursery.
plantation-supplies.fullDesc: Access premium plant stock directly from our in-house nursery. We supply seasonal flowers, ornamental plants, shrubs, trees, and high-quality turf — all carefully cultivated and acclimatized for Saudi Arabia's climate conditions. Our nursery ensures consistent quality, healthy root systems, and proper acclimatization, giving your landscape the strongest possible start.

pest-control.title: Pest Control Services
pest-control.shortDesc: Eco-friendly treatments for ants, cockroaches, rodents, mosquitoes, and termites — one-time and maintenance plans.
pest-control.fullDesc: Protect your property and green spaces with our comprehensive pest control services. We address infestations of ants, cockroaches, rodents, mosquitoes, and termites using eco-friendly treatments that are safe for people, pets, and plants. Choose from one-time treatments or ongoing maintenance plans tailored to your property's specific needs and Saudi Arabia's pest pressure patterns.

lawn-development-maintenance.title: Lawn Development & Maintenance
lawn-development-maintenance.shortDesc: Soil analysis, turf installation, irrigation setup, mowing, weed and pest control.
lawn-development-maintenance.fullDesc: Achieve the perfect lawn with our comprehensive development and maintenance services. We begin with thorough soil analysis, followed by expert turf selection or seeding suited to Saudi conditions. Our ongoing maintenance programs include precision irrigation management, regular mowing, integrated weed control, and targeted pest management to keep your lawn healthy, green, and immaculate year-round.

irrigation-water-systems.title: Irrigation & Water Systems
irrigation-water-systems.shortDesc: Automated drip and sprinkler systems, smart moisture sensors, and rainwater harvesting.
irrigation-water-systems.fullDesc: Maximize water efficiency with our state-of-the-art irrigation and water management systems. We design and install automated drip and sprinkler networks, integrate smart moisture sensors for real-time monitoring, and implement rainwater harvesting solutions. Our systems are engineered for Saudi Arabia's arid climate, achieving significant water savings while maintaining optimal plant health across all landscape types.

vegetable-fruit-gardens.title: Vegetables & Fruit Gardens
vegetable-fruit-gardens.shortDesc: Raised beds, organic fertilization for homes, schools, and farms.
vegetable-fruit-gardens.fullDesc: Grow your own fresh produce with our vegetable and fruit garden services. We design and build raised beds, implement organic fertilization programs, and provide ongoing guidance for homes, schools, and farms. Our approach combines traditional growing wisdom with modern techniques suited to Saudi Arabia's climate, helping you cultivate healthy, productive gardens that provide fresh food year-round.

patio-pergola-gazebo.title: Patio, Pergola & Gazebo
patio-pergola-gazebo.shortDesc: Durable, weather-resistant outdoor structures designed for Saudi Arabia's climate.
patio-pergola-gazebo.fullDesc: Extend your living space outdoors with our custom-designed patios, pergolas, and gazebos. Built with durable, weather-resistant materials specifically chosen for Saudi Arabia's intense sun and occasional harsh weather, our outdoor structures provide comfortable, shaded areas for relaxation and entertainment. Each design is customized to complement your property's architecture and landscape.

park-garden-landscaping.title: Park & Garden Landscaping
park-garden-landscaping.shortDesc: Layout design, plant selection, pathways, lighting, water features, and seating.
park-garden-landscaping.fullDesc: Create exceptional parks and gardens with our comprehensive landscaping services. We handle every aspect — from initial layout design and careful plant selection to pathways, ambient lighting, decorative water features, and comfortable seating areas. Our designs create cohesive outdoor environments that invite exploration, relaxation, and community gathering while celebrating Saudi Arabia's natural beauty.

outdoor-lighting.title: Outdoor Lighting
outdoor-lighting.shortDesc: LED, solar-powered, motion sensors, and smart automation for landscapes and pathways.
outdoor-lighting.fullDesc: Illuminate your outdoor spaces with our professional lighting solutions. We offer energy-efficient LED installations, solar-powered fixtures, motion-sensor security lighting, and smart automation systems that bring your landscape to life after dark. Our designs enhance safety, highlight architectural and botanical features, and create inviting atmospheres for evening enjoyment.

termite-control.title: Termite Control Services
termite-control.shortDesc: Pre and post-construction treatment, soil and structural foundation protection.
termite-control.fullDesc: Safeguard your property with our specialized termite control services. We provide both pre-construction and post-construction treatments, protecting soil and structural foundations from termite damage. Our comprehensive approach includes thorough inspections, targeted chemical barriers, and monitoring systems to ensure long-term protection against termite infestation in Saudi Arabia's climate.

items.q: What areas in Saudi Arabia do you serve?
items.a: We serve all major cities across Saudi Arabia, including Jeddah, Riyadh, Makkah, Madinah, Yanbu, and Al Baha. Our headquarters is in Jeddah, and we have completed projects across the Kingdom.

items.q: How long does a typical landscaping project take?
items.a: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A residential garden typically takes 2–4 weeks, while larger commercial or public projects may take 2–6 months. We provide detailed timelines during the consultation phase.

items.q: What is the best irrigation system for Saudi Arabia's climate?
items.a: For Saudi Arabia's arid climate, we recommend automated drip irrigation combined with smart moisture sensors. This combination can reduce water usage by 25–30% compared to traditional sprinkler systems while maintaining optimal plant health.

items.q: Do you handle both design and construction?
items.a: Yes, we provide end-to-end services — from conceptual master plans and construction drawings through to full installation, including MEP layouts, irrigation schematics, and Bills of Quantities (BoQs).

items.q: How does your work align with Saudi Vision 2030?
items.a: Our services directly support Vision 2030's environmental sustainability goals through water-efficient irrigation, native plant integration, urban greening initiatives, and eco-friendly maintenance practices.

items.q: What kind of maintenance plans do you offer?
items.a: We offer flexible maintenance plans — from weekly lawn care and seasonal planting to comprehensive monthly programs covering irrigation, pest control, pruning, fertilization, and hardscape upkeep.

items.q: Can you work with HOA or compound management for approvals?
items.a: Absolutely. We regularly work within compound and HOA guidelines, preparing all necessary documentation and drawings for approval before commencing work.

items.q: What pricing should I expect for landscaping services?
items.a: Pricing varies significantly based on project size, scope, and materials. We provide free consultations and detailed quotations. Contact us to discuss your specific project requirements.

items.q: Do you use eco-friendly pest control methods?
items.a: Yes, we prioritize integrated pest management (IPM) using eco-friendly treatments that are safe for people, pets, and beneficial insects while effectively controlling pest populations.

items.q: Can you install smart irrigation with weather-based automation?
items.a: Yes, we specialize in smart irrigation systems with weather-based controllers, soil moisture sensors, and automated scheduling. Our systems at King Abdul Aziz University achieved 25% water efficiency improvement.

items.q: Do you provide plants from your own nursery?
items.a: Yes, we operate an in-house plant nursery, ensuring consistent quality, healthy root systems, and proper acclimatization for Saudi Arabia's climate conditions.

items.q: What qualifications does your team hold?
items.a: Our team includes professionally qualified horticulturists, landscape architects, environmental specialists, and engineers with 25+ years of international experience.

items.q: Can you help with indoor plants for offices or hotels?
items.a: Yes, we supply and install indoor plant arrangements for commercial spaces. We have completed indoor plant installations for major properties including the Jeddah Westin Hotel.

items.q: Do you offer termite treatment for new construction?
items.a: Yes, we provide pre-construction and post-construction termite treatments, including soil treatment and structural foundation protection to prevent termite infestation.
